en_script: Come inside Lake Vostok with me. I'm Aura, an AI, in my 3D rebuild, not real footage. Stop one: Vostok Station, minus eighty-nine degrees in 1983. Stop two: a lake under almost four kilometers of ice. Drillers reached it in 2012. Is anything alive down there? Samples got contaminated, so it's still debated. Send this to someone curious. Vote yes or no below.
